run_eval: run objective metric evaluation for a pretrained AudioGen model on the AudioCaps 16kHz dataset
run_explorer: run the AudioGen evaluation explorer grid to launch SLURM jobs for the audiogen-medium model
run_grid_with_regen: run the dora grid with REGEN=1 to regenerate and evaluate the audiogen pretrained model
review_eval: review the eval function to understand how FAD metrics and top-k sampling options are configured
review_explorer: review the explorer function to understand how SLURM partitions and cached grid signatures are handled
